'''Fussball Club Basel 1893''', widely known as '''FC Basel''', '''FCB''', or just '''Basel''',<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2002/sep/25/minutebyminute.sport|title=Liverpool v FC Basle|date=26 September 2002 |access-date=24 August 2014|work=The Guardian|archive-date=9 September 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909195255/http://www.theguardian.com/football/2002/sep/25/minutebyminute.sport|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.express.co.uk/sport/football/394488/FC-Basle-fan-Roger-Federer-predicts-2-1-defeat-for-Chelsea|title=FC Basle fan Roger Federer predicts 2–1 defeat for Chelsea|date=24 April 2014|access-date=24 August 2014|work=Sunday Express|archive-date=23 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150923055922/http://www.express.co.uk/sport/football/394488/FC-Basle-fan-Roger-Federer-predicts-2-1-defeat-for-Chelsea|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/chelsea/10018489/FC-Basle-v-Chelsea-live.html|title=FC Basle vs Chelsea: live|date=25 April 2013|access-date=24 August 2014|work=The Telegraph|archive-date=4 April 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230404073319/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/chelsea/10018489/FC-Basle-v-Chelsea-live.html|url-status=live}}</ref> is a Swiss professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Basel]], in the [[Basel-Stadt|Canton of Basel-Stadt]]. Formed in 1893, the club has been [[List of Swiss football champions|Swiss national champions]] 21 times, [[Swiss Cup]] winners 14 times, and [[Swiss League Cup]] winners once.

Basel competed in [[UEFA competitions]] for 25 consecutive seasons between 1999–2000 and 2023–2024. They have qualified for the group stage of the [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] more times than any other Swiss club. They are the only Swiss club to have  qualified to this phase directly. Since 2001, the club has played its home games at [[St. Jakob-Park]], built on the site of their previous home, [[St. Jakob Stadium]]. Their home colours are red and blue, leading to a nickname of ''RotBlau''."}}
